Container.Name: goews-generator
Container.Overview: Self-hosted GOEWS part generator (web UI for the goews-rebuilt-openscad models). Generates tiles, tile stacks, shelves, bins, hooks and more as STL. The tile stack download also includes a 3MF with PLA and PETG preassigned, and optionally a STEP file of the PETG separators. Large stacks take a minute or two to generate.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web interface is served on. Change the host port if 8000 is already in use on your server.

Config.Name: Response timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: How long a single generation may take before it is cut off. Large stacks with STEP export can take a few minutes.
